title: Add chat stream idle watchdogs and bounded backpressure channels
description: Vetted from Audit #7 findings 3.1 and 3.2. Add per-chunk idle detection for Ollama streams and bounded channel/backpressure plus idle watchdog for GitHub/Copilot streaming to avoid indefinite hangs and unbounded buffering.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented stream reliability guardrails in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs`: Ollama now enforces per-chunk idle watchdog cancellation while waiting on `ReadLineAsync`; GitHub/Copilot streaming now uses a bounded channel (capacity 128) with explicit overflow failure and an idle watchdog that cancels stalled sessions before the global request timeout horizon. Added focused regression coverage in `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs` with `OllamaChatProvider_StreamAsync_ThrowsTimeoutWhenNoChunkArrives`. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~OllamaChatProvider_StreamAsync_ThrowsTimeoutWhenNoChunkArrives"` (pass) and `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~ChatProviders_ReportCapabilityMetadata|Name~GitHubCopilotChatProvider_FormatsPromptAsStructuredConversationEnvelope"` (2/2 passed).
